text_markup: During every paid ability window, the player with priority has the option to trigger an active paid ability they control. Players cannot trigger actions, interrupts, or mid-access abilities in a paid ability window. See {ref:sec_paid_abilities}. Within this document, paid ability windows are marked with the symbol (P) to denote the option to trigger a regular paid ability.
text_plain: During every paid ability window, the player with priority has the option to trigger an active paid ability they control.
